title: Detects documentation that is empty.
summary: Empty docs clutter code without adding value, reducing readability and maintainability. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for empty Drop implementations.
summary: Empty Drop implementations have no effect when dropping an instance of the type. They are most likely useless. However, an empty Drop implementation prevents a type from being destructured, which might be the intention behind adding the implementation as a marker. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Finds enum variants without fields that are declared with empty brackets.
summary: Empty brackets after a enum variant declaration are redundant and can be omitted, and it may be desirable to do so consistently for style. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for enums with no variants, which therefore are uninhabited types (cannot be instantiated).
summary: If you only want a type which can’t be instantiated, you should use ! (the primitive type “never”), because ! has more extensive compiler support (type inference, etc.) and implementations of common traits. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for empty lines after doc comments.
summary: The doc comment may have meant to be an inner doc comment, regular comment or applied to some old code that is now commented out. If it was intended to be a doc comment, then the empty line should be removed. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for empty lines after outer attributes
summary: The attribute may have meant to be an inner attribute (#![attr]). If it was meant to be an outer attribute (#[attr]) then the empty line should be removed Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for empty loop expressions.
summary: These busy loops burn CPU cycles without doing anything. It is almost always a better idea to panic! than to have a busy loop. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Finds structs without fields (a so-called “empty struct”) that are declared with brackets.
summary: Empty brackets after a struct declaration can be omitted, and it may be desirable to do so consistently for style. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
